title: IVG Smart Max Watermelon Strawberry Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Watermelon Strawberry pairs two classic fruit notes into one fresh and satisfying vape. The Watermelon brings a light, juicy flavour while the Strawberry adds a soft sweetness, resulting in a balanced and mellow profile with plenty of flavour. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 10ml refill reservoir. Once clicked into place, the refill automatically tops up the pod and can last up to 10,000 puffs depending on your vaping habits. Mesh coil technology ensures smooth MTL vapour with reliable flavour delivery. Made exclusively for the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
